This confirms the issue. `_all_of_type` filters to only `DataArray` (or `Dataset`) objects. When `x` is a scalar like `1`, it's not a `DataArray`, so `objs` only contains `cond` (index 0). The `attrs` list passed to the lambda has only 1 element (from `cond`), so `attrs[1]` raises `IndexError`.

The fix is correct: `attrs[1] if len(attrs) > 1 else {}` returns an empty dict when `x` is scalar (no attrs to preserve), and preserves `x`'s attrs when `x` is a DataArray.

**Fix**: Changed line 1832 in `xarray/core/computation.py` to guard against `IndexError` when `x` is a scalar (has no `.attrs`). The lambda now returns `{}` if the attrs list is too short, instead of blindly indexing `attrs[1]`.
